notes.starter3d.logo: The engine's name, as its logo on the title screen: keep it as written.
notes.starter3d.logo.3d: The second half of the logo, under the engine's name: the 3D edition. Keep it as short.
notes.starter3d.prompt: A button prompt: {key} is the key or button, {word} what it does (a line of its own), e.g. "J combo".
notes.starter3d.how.keys: The title screen's key help: two hints separated by three spaces. Keep the key names (Enter, M).
notes.starter3d.note.view: {view} is the camera view's name (iso, three-quarter, top-down); shown in capitals.
notes.starter3d.camera.chase: A camera that follows behind the player's character.
notes.starter3d.over.clear: The title of the screen after a game is won, when the game gives no title of its own.
notes.starter3d.over.title: Back to the title screen (the menu of games).
notes.starter3d.boot.title_stage: A step on the loading screen: building the little stage the title screen shows.
notes.starter3d.slice.crawler: A dungeon crawler: a role-playing game in a dungeon seen in first person.
notes.starter3d.slice.flight.about: On rails: the flight follows a fixed path; then the boss is fought flying freely.
notes.action.lock: Locks the camera on the nearest enemy (the controls screen).

brief: The my-3D2dge 3D starter: a title menu of small 3D games, one per genre, each a complete slice to copy and change. Its menus and notices are short, arcade-like, mostly in capitals; keep them short, since they sit on a 320 x 240 screen over the 3D picture. The player is unnamed and unseen in the menus; address them with the familiar "you" where a line needs one.
